definitions.explanation: a small flat piece used to pluck or strum stringed instruments

examples.japanese: ピックでギターを{弾|ひ}く。
examples.english: To play guitar with a pick.

examples.japanese: {薄|うす}いピックのほうが{弾|ひ}きやすい。
examples.english: A thin pick is easier to play with.

examples.japanese: ピックを{持|も}つ{位置|いち}を{調整|ちょうせい}する。
examples.english: To adjust the position of holding the pick.

notes:
From English "pick." In Japanese, ピック almost exclusively refers to a guitar pick (plectrum). The broader English senses of "pick" are expressed differently in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピックで{弾|ひ}く: to play with a pick
- ピックを{持|も}つ: to hold a pick
- ピック{弾|び}き: pick-style playing

TYPES BY MATERIAL:
- プラスチック (plastic) — most common
- べっ{甲|こう} (tortoiseshell) — traditional
- {金属|きんぞく} (metal)

TYPES BY THICKNESS:
- {薄|うす}い (thin) — flexible, good for strumming
- {厚|あつ}い (thick) — rigid, good for single-note picking

RELATED WORDS:
- {指|ゆび}ピック: finger pick
- フィンガーピッキング: fingerpicking (playing without a pick)
